<title>LARP LIFE — Clicker</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0b10;--panel:#15151e;--panel2:#1e1e2a;--line:#333344;--text:#f7f4ff;--muted:#aaa7bd;--gold:#ffcf5a;--pink:#ff6ac1;--green:#6ce4a0;--purple:#9c82ff}

5px 25px #ffcf5a33}.tag{font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:900}.topright{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.pill{border:1px solid i{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pink),var(--gold));width:10%;transition:width .25s}.sectiontitle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}.sectiontitle h2{margin:0;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.4px}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.upgrade{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:210px}.upgrade-icon{height:47px;width:47px;border-radius:14px;background:#30243e;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px}.upgrade h3{font-size:16px;margin:0}.upgrade p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;flex:1}.upgrade-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-top:3px}.price{color:var(--gold);font-weight:900}.upgrade button{font-size:12px;padding:9px 11px}.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:18px}.quest{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.quest:last-child{border-bottom:0}.check{width:25px;height:25px;border:1px solid #5b4a6d;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);flex-shrink:0}.quest b{display:block}.quest p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.quest button{margin-left:auto;padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.log{display:grid;gap:9px;max-height:235px;overflow:auto}.logitem{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#ffffff05;font-size:12px}.logitem span:last-child{color:var(--green);font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}.footer{color:#777488;text-align:center;font-size:11px;padding:26px 0 8px}.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:#f7f4ff;color:#16121f;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 17px;font-weight:850;opacity:0;transition:.2s;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #0006}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}.reset{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:transparent}.tiny{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.workgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin:18px 0}.jobstats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin:15px 0}.jobstat{background:#ffffff07;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:12px;padding:12px}.jobstat b{display:block;font-size:18px;color:var(--gold)}.jobstat span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.shiftbtn{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6ce4a0,#3ebf88);color:#10251a;border:0}.jobbar{height:8px;border-radius:9px;background:#34313c;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}.jobbar i{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6ce4a0,#ffcf5a);width:0}.statusgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:18px 14px}.tabbtn{background:#191722;border-color:#393344}.tabbtn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffcf5a,#ff9e55);color:#201523;border-color:transparent}.tabpane{display:none}.tabpane.active{display:block}.billgrid,.housegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.bill{border:1px #59446b;border-radius:17px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#34274b,#1b1b2a);transition:background .2s}.housepreview .emoji{font-size:55px}.houseitem{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.houseitem p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;flex:1}.houseitem button{font-size:12px}.billpay{background:#45202c;border-color:#78364b}.billpay:disabled{opacity:.4}.closet-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#ffffff05}.closet-item .cloth-icon{font-size:25px}.closet-item .cloth-info{flex:1;min-width:0}.closet-item small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}.closet-item button{font-size:11px;padding:8px 10px}.closet-item.equipped{border-color:#53b8ff;background:#53b8ff12}.creator-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:16px}.studio-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#25203b,#171722);margin-bottom:14px}.studio-avatar{width:56px;height:56px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#ff3355;font-size:26px}.studio-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}.studio-input{display:block;width:100%;margin:6px 0 12px;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#11111a;color:var(--text);font:inherit}.studio-video{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#ffffff06;margin:8px 0}.studio-video b{display:block}.message-card{padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin:8px 0;background:#ffffff05}.message-card p{margin:5px 0 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.message-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.message-actions button{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px}.finance-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.market-grid,.gig-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.market-card,.gig-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:14px;background:#ffffff05}.market-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.market-card .market-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center}.market-price{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold)}.market-controls{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.market-controls input{width:72px;background:#11111a;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:8px}.gig-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.gig-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;flex:1}.gig-card button{width:100%}.finance-stat{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff06;border-radius:13px;padding:14px}.finance-stat b{display:block;font-size:22px;color:var(--gold)}.finance-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.finance-actions input{width:130px;max-width:100%;background:#11111a;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font:inherit}.course{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid 10px}@media(max-width:650px){.finance-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:850px){.creator-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:850px){.billgrid,.housegrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:520px){.billgrid,.housegrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:850px){.workgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.statusgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:850px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.two-col{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-main:after{font-size:110px;right:5px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.wrap{padding:13px}.top{align-items:flex-start}.logo{font-size:18px}.topright{justify-content:flex-end}.pill{display:none}.card{padding:15px;border-radius:16px}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.upgrade{min-height:180px}.statgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.stat{padding:9px}.stat b{font-size:17px}.hero h1{font-size:40px}.bigmoney{font-size:36px}.sectiontitle{align-items:flex-start}}

/* LarpGPT desktop buddy */
.larpgpt-buddy{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:9px;user-select:none}
.larpgpt-mascot{width:76px;height:88px;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 15px #0008);cursor:grab;flex-shrink:0}
.larpgpt-mascot svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}.larpgpt-mascot:active{cursor:grabbing}
.larpgpt-bubble{background:#fff9e9;color:#2b2036;border:2px solid #9c82ff;border-radius:14px 14px 3px 14px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;max-width:165px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0006;margin-bottom:40px}
.larpgpt-panel{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:118px;width:min(355px,calc(100vw - 28px));height:440px;max-height:65vh;z-index:31;background:#171520;border:1px solid #7257a2;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #0009;display:none;overflow:hidden;flex-direction:column}
.larpgpt-panel.open{display:flex}.larpgpt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#39234e,#211c30);border-bottom:1px solid #443553}.larpgpt-head .buddy-face{font-size:27px}.larpgpt-head strong{display:block}.larpgpt-head small{color:#b8eecb;font-size:11px}.larpgpt-head button{margin-left:auto;padding:5px 9px}
.larpgpt-tools{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 10px 0}.larpgpt-tools button{font-size:10px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:9px}.larpgpt-chat{padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;overflow:auto;flex:1;min-height:0}.larpgpt-msg{max-width:90%;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.larpgpt-msg.bot{align-self:flex-start;background:#2a2438;border:1px solid #514166}.larpgpt-msg.user{align-self:flex-end;background:#f3d27b;color:#2b2036;font-weight:700}.larpgpt-compose{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:10px;border-top:1px solid #383044}.larpgpt-compose input{min-width:0;flex:1;background:#0e0d14;color:#fff;border:1px solid #494055;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font:inherit}.larpgpt-compose button{padding:9px 11px}.larpgpt-note{padding:0 11px 8px;color:#9992ad;font-size:10px}.larpgpt-buddy.hidden .larpgpt-bubble{display:none}
@media(max-width:600px){.larpgpt-buddy{right:10px;bottom:12px}.larpgpt-mascot{width:62px;height:73px}.larpgpt-panel{right:10px;bottom:94px;height:420px}.larpgpt-bubble{max-width:125px;margin-bottom:30px}}


/* Cozy snowfall + cursor click sparkles */
#larpSnowLayer{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:25;contain:strict}
.larp-snowflake{position:absolute;top:-24px;left:var(--x);color:#fff;opacity:var(--opacity);font-size:var(--size);text-shadow:0 0 8px #bfeaff99;animation:larpSnowFall var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite;will-change:transform}
@keyframes larpSnowFall{0%{transform:translate3d(0,-5vh,0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translate3d(var(--drift),52vh,0) rotate(180deg)}100%{transform:translate3d(calc(var(--drift) * -.45),110vh,0) rotate(360deg)}}
.larp-click-sparkle{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;font-size:var(--sz);line-height:1;color:var(--sparkle-color);text-shadow:0 0 8px currentColor,0 0 18px #c9a6ff;animation:larpSparklePop 720ms ease-out forwards;will-change:transform,opacity}
@keyframes larpSparklePop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.25) rotate(0deg)}18%{opacity:1;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx1)),calc(-50% + var(--dy1))) scale(1.15) rotate(35deg)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx2)),calc(-50% + var(--dy2))) scale(.1) rotate(160deg)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.larp-snowflake{animation-duration:45s!important}.larp-click-sparkle{animation-duration:350ms}}


/* Nitro-inspired customizable player profile */
.profile-cover{min-height:145px;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;padding:20px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#6d42d8,#ec69bc 55%,#ffce73)}.profile-cover:after{content:"✦  ✧  ✦";position:absolute;right:18px;top:12px;font-size:38px;letter-spacing:10px;color:#ffffff55;pointer-events:none}.profile-body{padding:0 20px 20px;background:#171620;border:1px solid #393344;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px}.profile-avatar{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:28px;border:6px solid #171620;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a58aff,#53b8ff);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:43px;margin-top:-43px;position:relative;z-index:1;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0005}.profile-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:1px solid #69538c;background:#302542;color:#e4d8ff;border-radius:7px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;margin:3px 4px 3px 0}.profile-field{display:block;width:100%;margin:6px 0 12px;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#11111a;color:var(--text);font:inherit}.profile-theme-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.profile-theme{width:39px;height:39px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #ffffff40}.profile-theme.selected{outline:2px solid white;outline-offset:2px}.profile-decor{animation:profileGlow 2.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes profileGlow{from{box-shadow:0 0 12px #a58aff20}to{box-shadow:0 0 25px var(--profile-accent,#a58aff55)}}@media(max-width:760px){.profile-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}}
/* Community-style game themes */
body[data-game-theme="midnight"]{--bg:#080b18;--panel:#10172a;--panel2:#18243b;--line:#293d60;--text:#e8f2ff;--muted:#92a9c8;--gold:#7dd3fc;--pink:#a78bfa;--green:#5eead4;--purple:#60a5fa;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#19365d 0,#0d1325 38%,var(--bg) 75%)}
body[data-game-theme="amoled"]{--bg:#000;--panel:#050505;--panel2:#101010;--line:#292929;--text:#f5f5f5;--muted:#aaa;--gold:#fff;--pink:#ff4fd8;--green:#4dff9a;--purple:#b18cff;background:#000}
body[data-game-theme="dracula"]{--bg:#191a2a;--panel:#222338;--panel2:#303149;--line:#484966;--text:#f8f8f2;--muted:#b8b8cf;--gold:#f1fa8c;--pink:#ff79c6;--green:#50fa7b;--purple:#bd93f9;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#563b75 0,#28243d 40%,var(--bg) 75%)}
body[data-game-theme="nord"]{--bg:#242d3b;--panel:#2e394a;--panel2:#3a475b;--line:#4b5a70;--text:#eceff4;--muted:#b7c3d5;--gold:#ebcb8b;--pink:#b48ead;--green:#a3be8c;--purple:#88c0d0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#52667f 0,#303b4d 40%,var(--bg) 75%)}
body[data-game-theme="synthwave"]{--bg:#160b27;--panel:#241039;--panel2:#32134a;--line:#61276f;--text:#fff0ff;--muted:#d1a8d9;--gold:#ffe66d;--pink:#ff4fd8;--green:#53ffd4;--purple:#a855f7;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#772c8c 0,#291039 42%,var(--bg) 76%)}
body[data-game-theme="forest"]{--bg:#091711;--panel:#11251b;--panel2:#193528;--line:#2c5941;--text:#edfff2;--muted:#a6c9b1;--gold:#e5d27a;--pink:#ed9bba;--green:#6ce4a0;--purple:#8ed5a5;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#24583b 0,#12291d 40%,var(--bg) 75%)}
body[data-game-theme="custom"]{--bg:var(--custom-bg,#0b0b10);--panel:var(--custom-panel,#15151e);--panel2:var(--custom-panel2,#1e1e2a);--line:var(--custom-line,#333344);--text:var(--custom-text,#f7f4ff);--muted:var(--custom-muted,#aaa7bd);--gold:var(--custom-accent,#ffcf5a);--pink:var(--custom-accent,#ff6ac1);--green:var(--custom-accent,#6ce4a0);--purple:var(--custom-accent,#9c82ff);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--custom-accent,#9c82ff) 35%,transparent),transparent 48%),var(--bg)}
body[data-game-theme] .card,body[data-game-theme] .market-card,body[data-game-theme] .gig-card,body[data-game-theme] .bill,body[data-game-theme] .finance-stat{background-color:var(--panel);border-color:var(--line)}
body[data-game-theme] .tabbtn{background:var(--panel);border-color:var(--line)}body[data-game-theme] .tabbtn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--pink));color:#17121d}
body[data-game-theme] .profile-field,body[data-game-theme] .studio-input{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--line)}
.theme-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:15px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.theme-swatch{height:62px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ffffff22}.theme-card button{width:100%}.theme-card.selected{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}.theme-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}@media(max-width:760px){.theme-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}


.music-on{color:#ffcf5a!important;border-color:#806b37!important;background:#ffcf5a12!important}
#musicToggle{white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:600px){#musicToggle{font-size:10px;padding:8px}}

/* iOS 26-inspired glass interface + uploaded looping background */
html{background:#070910}
body{background:transparent!important;position:relative;isolation:isolate}
#larpVideoBackground{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background:#080910}
#larpVideoShade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,8,15,.38),rgba(6,8,15,.58)),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(120,150,255,.12),transparent 65%)}
.wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.card,.rankbox,.stat,.quest,.logitem,.theme-card,.upgrade,.tab-pane,.panel,.modal-content,.modal-card,
.profile-card,.studio-card,.section,.stock-card,.job-card,.settings-card{
 background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.17),rgba(255,255,255,.055))!important;
 border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.23)!important;
 box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.17),0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.22),0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;
 -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(165%);backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(165%);
}
.card{border-radius:24px}
.hero-main{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.2),rgba(135,112,210,.12))!important}
.rankbox,.stat,.theme-card,.upgrade{border-radius:18px}
button,.pill,.tabbtn,.profile-field,.studio-input,input,select,textarea{
 -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);
}
button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24)}
button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff}
.top{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:24px;background:rgba(20,22,32,.32);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(30px) saturate(180%);backdrop-filter:blur(30px) saturate(180%)}
.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,213,115,.96),rgba(255,151,102,.94))!important}
.purplebtn{background:rgba(173,135,255,.28)!important}
.tabbtn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.17)!important}
.tabbtn.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)!important;color:#fff!important}
body[data-game-theme] .profile-field,body[data-game-theme] .studio-input{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)!important;color:var(--text);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#larpVideoBackground{display:none}}

</style>
</head>

<section class="tabpane" id="financePane"><div class="sectiontitle"><h2>📈 Money, savings & skills</h2><span class="smallmuted">Build a life, not just a flex</span></div><div class="finance-grid"><article class="card"><div class="sectiontitle"><h2>🏦 Emergency savings</h2><span class="pill">LOW RISK</span></div><p class="smallmuted">Move money out of your spendable cash so you have a cushion for surprise bills. function compact(n){if(n>=1e12)return (n/1e12).toFixed(2)+'T';if(n>=1e9)return (n/1e9).toFixed(2)+'B';if(n>=1e6)return (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+'M';if(n>=1e4)return (n/1e3).toFixed(1)+'K';return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('en-US')}
function cost(u){return Math.floor(u.base*Math.pow(u.growth,u.owned))}
function job(){return [...jobs].reverse().find(j=>game.shifts>=j.need&&(game.workXP||0)>=j.xp)||jobs[0]}
function nextJob(){return jobs.find(j=>j!==job()&&(game.shifts<j.need||(game.workXP||0)<j.xp))}
function work(){const now=Date.now();if((game.shiftReadyAt||0)>now){notify('Shift in progress — finish in '+Math.ceil((game.shiftReadyAt-now)/1000)+' seconds.');return}game.shiftReadyAt=now+60000;game.shiftStartedAt=now;$('#workBtn').disabled=true;$('#workBtn').textContent='⏳ Shift in progress… 60s';notify('Shift started! Wait one minute to finish.');renderWork();saveSilent()}
function finishShift(){const before=job(),basePay=before.pay*4+Math.floor((game.workXP||0)/15),pay=Math.floor(basePay*((game.courses||[]).includes('foodSafety')?1.12:1));game.cash+=pay;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+pay;game.shifts=(game.shifts||0)+1;game.workXP=(game.workXP||0)+12;game.shiftReadyAt=0;gainXP(18);game.shiftFeed=game.shiftFeed||[];game.shiftFeed.unshift({msg:'Completed 4-hour shift as '+before.title,pay});game.shiftFeed=game.shiftFeed.slice(0,8);addFeed('Finished a shift at LARP Burger.','+$'+compact(pay));render();checkQuests();notify(job().title!==before.title?'PROMOTION! '+job().title:'Payday! +$'+compact(pay)+' LARP Bucks');saveSilent()}
function tickShift(){const btn=$('#workBtn');const remaining=(game.shiftReadyAt||0)-Date.now();if(remaining>0){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='⏳ Shift in progress… '+Math.ceil(remaining/1000)+'s'}else if(game.shiftReadyAt){finishShift()}else{btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='🍔 Start a 4-hour shift (1 min wait)'}}

function house(){return houseLevels[Math.max(0,Math.min(houseLevels.length-1,(game.houseLevel||1)-1))]}
function bills(){const h=house();let rent=[30,65,140,350,900,2800,9000][h.level-1]||30;let utilities=[10,18,30,65,150,500,1600][h.level-1]||10;let food=15+Math.floor((game.upgrades.find(u=>u.id==='groceries')||{owned:0}).owned*2);if((game.houseOwned||[]).includes('solar'))utilities=Math.ceil(utilities*.5);return {rent,utilities,food,total:rent+utilities+food}}
const paintOptions=[{id:'purple',label:'💜 Purple',cost:0},{id:'blue',label:'💙 Blue',cost:250},{id:'green',label:'💚 Green',cost:500},{id:'gold',label:'💛 Gold',cost:2500},{id:'rose',label:'🩷 Rose',cost:1200},{id:'cream',label:'🤍 Cream',cost:900},{id:'midnight',label:'🖤 Midnight',cost:5000}];
const decorOptions=[{id:'minimal',label:'🪴 Minimal',cost:0},{id:'gamer',label:'🎮 Gamer',cost:750},{id:'cozy',label:'🧸 Cozy',cost:900},{id:'modern',label:'✨ Modern',cost:3000},{id:'royal',label:'👑 Royal',cost:25000}];
function renderHouse(){const h=house();$('#houseName').textContent=h.name;$('#houseEmoji').textContent=h.emoji;$('#houseDesc').textContent=h.desc;$('#houseLevel').textContent=h.level;$('#houseValue').textContent='$'+compact(h.cost);const paints={purple:'linear-gradient(135deg,#34274b,#1b1b2a)',blue:'linear-gradient(135deg,#1c4260,#171b2c)',green:'linear-gradient(135deg,#214b3b,#171f25)',gold:'linear-gradient(135deg,#5b4823,#201a22)',rose:'linear-gradient(135deg,#63334f,#251b2a)',cream:'linear-gradient(135deg,#756d5e,#29242a)',midnight:'linear-gradient(135deg,#101521,#252037)'};$('#housePreview').style.background=paints[game.housePaint||'purple'];const decors={minimal:'Minimal',gamer:'Gamer',cozy:'Cozy',modern:'Modern',royal:'Royal'};if($('#decorLabel'))$('#decorLabel').textContent='Current style: '+decors[game.houseDecor||'minimal'];
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-paint]').forEach(b=>{const o=paintOptions.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.paint);if(!o)return;const owned=(game.paintOwned||['purple']).includes(o.id);b.textContent=(game.housePaint===o.id?'✓ ':'')+o.label+(owned?'': ' · $'+compact(o.cost));b.disabled=!owned&&game.cash<o.cost;b.style.opacity=game.housePaint===o.id?'1':'.9'});
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-decor]').forEach(b=>{const o=decorOptions.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.decor);if(!o)return;const owned=(game.decorOwned||['minimal']).includes(o.id);b.textContent=(game.houseDecor===o.id?'✓ ':'')+o.label+(owned?'': ' · $'+compact(o.cost));b.disabled=!owned&&game.cash<o.cost;b.style.opacity=game.houseDecor===o.id?'1':'.9'});
 $('#houseUpgrades').innerHTML='';houseLevels.slice(1).forEach(x=>{if(x.level<=(game.houseLevel||1))return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='logitem';const info=document.createElement('span');info.textContent=x.emoji+' '+x.name+' · Level '+x.level;const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent='$'+compact(x.cost);b.disabled=game.cash<x.cost||x.level>(game.houseLevel||1)+1;b.onclick=()=>{if(game.cash<x.cost||(x.level>(game.houseLevel||1)+1))return;game.cash-=x.cost;game.houseLevel=x.level;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+x.cost;game.houseOwned=[];game.housePaint='purple';game.houseDecor='minimal';game.paintOwned=['purple'];game.decorOwned=['minimal'];addFeed('Moved into '+x.name,'Home level '+x.level+' · customizations reset');render();saveSilent();notify('Moved into '+x.name+'! New house, fresh customization budget.')};el.append(info,b);$('#houseUpgrades').append(el)});houseItems.forEach(x=>{if((game.houseOwned||[]).includes(x.id))return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='logitem';const info=document.createElement('span');info.textContent=x.icon+' '+x.name+' — '+x.desc;const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent='$'+compact(x.cost);b.disabled=game.cash<x.cost||(game.houseLevel||1)<x.level;b.onclick=()=>{if(game.cash<x.cost||(game.houseLevel||1)<x.level)return;game.cash-=x.cost;game.houseOwned.push(x.id);game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+x.cost;addFeed('Home improvement: '+x.name,'-$'+compact(x.cost));render();saveSilent();notify(x.name+' installed!')};el.append(info,b);$('#houseUpgrades').append(el)});const bi=bills();$('#rentBill').textContent='$'+compact(bi.rent);$('#utilityBill').textContent='$'+compact(bi.utilities);$('#foodBill').textContent='$'+compact(bi.food);$('#totalBill').textContent='$'+compact(bi.total)}
function payBills(){const b=bills();if(game.cash>=b.total){game.cash-=b.total;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0);game.lateBills=0;addFeed('Paid rent, utilities & essentials','-$'+compact(b.total));notify('Bills paid: -$'+compact(b.total))}else{const penalty=Math.min(game.cash,Math.ceil(b.total*.35));game.cash-=penalty;game.lateBills=(game.lateBills||0)+1;game.clout=Math.max(0,game.clout-10);addFeed('Missed bills — late fee and reputation hit','-$'+compact(penalty));notify('Bills overdue! Earn cash before next cycle.')}render()}
function renderBillTimer(){const secs=Math.max(0,300-(game.billTicks||0));const h=Math.floor(secs/3600),m=Math.floor((secs%3600)/60),ss=secs%60;$('#billTimer').textContent='Next bill in '+(h?h+'h ':'')+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+'m '+String(ss).padStart(2,'0')+'s'}
function perSec(){return game.upgrades.reduce((s,u)=>s+u.owned*u.rate,0)+((game.courses||[]).includes('business101')?5:0)}
function clickPower(){return 1+game.upgrades.reduce((s,u)=>s+u.owned*u.click,0)}
function aura(){return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.floor(game.clout/25)+game.upgrades.reduce((s,u)=>s+u.owned*3,0)-(game.auraPenalty||0)))}
function notify(s){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=s;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2200)}
function addFeed(msg,reward=''){game.feed.unshift({msg,reward});game.feed=game.feed.slice(0,30);renderFeed()}
function save(){persistProfile();notify('Game and profile saved in this browser.');} 
const profileBanners={galaxy:'linear-gradient(125deg,#352071,#9b4de2 48%,#e85da8)',sunset:'linear-gradient(125deg,#ff6a5c,#b743c9 55%,#ffbd69)',ocean:'linear-gradient(125deg,#082f49,#167d9a 55%,#74d9f2)',forest:'linear-gradient(125deg,#123d32,#23805a 55%,#b5d96b)',gold:'linear-gradient(125deg,#593d0c,#c58a21 55%,#ffe39a)',pink:'linear-gradient(125deg,#a72f87,#ef83c7 55%,#ffc5e6)'};
const defaultThemeCustom={bg:'#0b0b10',panel:'#15151e',panel2:'#1e1e2a',accent:'#9c82ff',text:'#f7f4ff',muted:'#aaa7bd'};
function applyGameTheme(name,custom){const allowed=['default','midnight','amoled','dracula','nord','synthwave','forest','custom'];if(!allowed.includes(name))name='default';game.theme=game.theme||{};game.theme.name=name;if(custom)game.theme.custom={...defaultThemeCustom,...custom};const t=game.theme.custom||defaultThemeCustom;document.body.dataset.gameTheme=name;Object.entries({bg:'--custom-bg',panel:'--custom-panel',panel2:'--custom-panel2',accent:'--custom-accent',text:'--custom-text',muted:'--custom-muted'}).forEach(([k,v])=>document.body.style.setProperty(v,t[k]||defaultThemeCustom[k]));document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-card]').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('selected',c.dataset.themeCard===name));[['customThemeBg','bg'],['customThemePanel','panel'],['customThemePanel2','panel2'],['customThemeAccent','accent'],['customThemeText','text'],['customThemeMuted','muted']].forEach(([id,k])=>{const e=$('#'+id);if(e)e.value=t[k]||defaultThemeCustom[k]});saveSilent()}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-game-theme-choice]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{applyGameTheme(b.dataset.gameThemeChoice);notify('Theme applied: '+b.dataset.gameThemeChoice+' ✨')}));
$('#applyCustomTheme')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const c={bg:$('#customThemeBg').value,panel:$('#customThemePanel').value,panel2:$('#customThemePanel2').value,accent:$('#customThemeAccent').value,text:$('#customThemeText').value,muted:$('#customThemeMuted').value};applyGameTheme('custom',c);notify('Custom theme applied and saved!')});
$('#exportThemeBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const t=game.theme||{name:'default',custom:defaultThemeCustom};$('#themeJsonBox').value=JSON.stringify({name:t.name,custom:t.custom||defaultThemeCustom},null,2);$('#themeJsonBox').focus();$('#themeJsonBox').select();try{document.execCommand('copy');notify('Theme JSON exported and copied if clipboard access is allowed.')}catch(e){notify('Theme JSON ready to copy.')}});
$('#importThemeBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const d=JSON.parse($('#themeJsonBox').value);const validColor=v=>typeof v==='string'&&/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v);const src=d.custom||{};const c={};Object.keys(defaultThemeCustom).forEach(k=>c[k]=validColor(src[k])?src[k]:defaultThemeCustom[k]);const n=['default','midnight','amoled','dracula','nord','synthwave','forest','custom'].includes(d.name)?d.name:'custom';applyGameTheme(n,c);notify('Theme imported!')}catch(e){notify('Invalid theme JSON. Paste an exported theme first.')}});
function renderProfile(){const p=game.profile||(game.profile={name:'Player',handle:'player',avatar:'😎',about:'Just a player building the ultimate LARP life ✨',banner:'galaxy',accent:'#a58aff',badge:'💎 Nitro Vibes'});const put=(id,v)=>{const e=$('#'+id);if(e)e.textContent=v};const cover=$('#profileCover'),preview=$('#profilePreview'),avatarEl=$('#profileAvatarPreview');if(cover){cover.style.background=p.bannerImage?'center/cover no-repeat url(\"'+p.bannerImage+'\")':(profileBanners[p.banner]||profileBanners.galaxy);cover.style.backgroundSize='cover';cover.style.backgroundPosition='center';}if(preview)preview.style.setProperty('--profile-accent',p.accent||'#a58aff');if(avatarEl){avatarEl.textContent='';if(p.avatarImage){const im=document.createElement('img');im.src=p.avatarImage;im.alt='Uploaded profile picture';im.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:inherit';avatarEl.appendChild(im)}else avatarEl.textContent=p.avatar||'😎'}put('profileNamePreview',p.name||'Player');put('profileHandlePreview','@'+(p.handle||'player')+' · LARP LIFE');put('profileAboutPreview',p.about||'No bio yet.');put('profileBadgePreview',p.badge||'💎 Nitro Vibes');put('profileStatsPreview','');const stats=$('#profileStatsPreview');if(stats){[['⭐ Level '+game.level],['🎬 '+(game.studioVideos||[]).length+' videos'],['✨ '+aura()+' aura']].forEach(t=>{const b=document.createElement('span');b.className='profile-badge';b.textContent=t[0];stats.append(b)})}document.querySelectorAll('[data-profile-color]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('selected',b.dataset.profileColor===(p.accent||'#a58aff')))}
function fillProfileEditor(){const p=game.profile||{};[['profileName',p.name||'Player'],['profileHandle',p.handle||'player'],['profileAvatar',p.avatar||'😎'],['profileAbout',p.about||'Just a player building the ultimate LARP life ✨'],['profileBanner',p.banner||'galaxy'],['profileBadge',p.badge||'💎 Nitro Vibes']].forEach(([id,v])=>{const e=$('#'+id);if(e)e.value=v});renderProfile()}
function readProfileEditor(){const val=id=>($('#'+id)?.value||'').trim();game.profile={...(game.profile||{}),name:val('profileName').slice(0,28)||'Player',handle:val('profileHandle').replace(/^@/,'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.]/g,'').slice(0,24)||'player',avatar:val('profileAvatar')||'😎',about:val('profileAbout').slice(0,180),banner:val('profileBanner')||'galaxy',badge:val('profileBadge')||'💎 Nitro Vibes'};renderProfile()}
['profileName','profileHandle','profileAvatar','profileAbout','profileBanner','profileBadge'].forEach(id=>$('#'+id)?.addEventListener('input',()=>{readProfileEditor();persistProfileText();if(id==='profileBanner')renderProfile()}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-profile-color]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{game.profile=game.profile||{};game.profile.accent=b.dataset.profileColor;renderProfile();saveSilent()}));$('#profileSaveBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{readProfileEditor();saveSilent();notify('Your profile is saved! ✨')});$('#profileResetBtn')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{game.profile={name:'Player',handle:'player',avatar:'😎',about:'Just a player building the ultimate LARP life ✨',banner:'galaxy',accent:'#a58aff',badge:'💎 Nitro Vibes'};fillProfileEditor();saveSilent();notify('Profile appearance reset.')});
function handleProfileImageUpload(inputId,field,label){const input=$('#'+inputId);if(!input)return;input.addEventListener('change',()=>{const file=input.files&&input.files[0];if(!file)return;if(!['image/png','image/gif'].includes(file.type)&&!(/\.(png|gif)$/i.test(file.name))){notify('Choose a PNG or GIF image.');input.value='';return}if(file.size>10*1024*1024){notify('That image is too large. Keep it under 10 MB.');input.value='';return}const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>{game.profile=game.profile||{};game.profile[field]=String(reader.result);readProfileEditor();saveSilent();notify(label+' uploaded! Save data stays in this browser.');input.value=''};reader.onerror=()=>notify('Could not read that image. Try another file.');reader.readAsDataURL(file)})}handleProfileImageUpload('profileAvatarUpload','avatarImage','Profile picture');handleProfileImageUpload('profileBannerUpload','bannerImage','Profile banner');$('#removeProfileAvatar')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{game.profile=game.profile||{};delete game.profile.avatarImage;renderProfile();saveSilent();notify('Uploaded avatar removed.')});$('#removeProfileBanner')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{game.profile=game.profile||{};delete game.profile.bannerImage;renderProfile();saveSilent();notify('Custom banner removed.')});
const PROFILE_DB='larpLifeProfileDB',PROFILE_STORE='assets';
function profileDb(){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(!('indexedDB'in window)){reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable'));return}const req=indexedDB.open(PROFILE_DB,1);req.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(PROFILE_STORE))req.result.createObjectStore(PROFILE_STORE)};req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result);req.onerror=()=>reject(req.error||new Error('Could not open profile storage'))})}
async function storeProfileAsset(key,value){const db=await profileDb();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction(PROFILE_STORE,'readwrite');if(value)tx.objectStore(PROFILE_STORE).put(value,key);else tx.objectStore(PROFILE_STORE).delete(key);tx.oncomplete=()=>{db.close();resolve()};tx.onerror=()=>{db.close();reject(tx.error||new Error('Profile storage failed'))}})}
async function getProfileAsset(key){const db=await profileDb();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction(PROFILE_STORE,'readonly'),req=tx.objectStore(PROFILE_STORE).get(key);req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result||'');req.onerror=()=>reject(req.error||new Error('Profile read failed'));tx.oncomplete=()=>db.close()})}
function persistProfileText(){try{const p={...(game.profile||{})};delete p.avatarImage;delete p.bannerImage;localStorage.setItem('larpLifeProfile',JSON.stringify(p));localStorage.setItem('larpLifeSave',JSON.stringify({...game,profile:p}))}catch(e){notify('Could not save profile text. Browser storage may be full.')}}
function persistProfile(){try{const p={...(game.profile||{})},avatarImage=p.avatarImage||'',bannerImage=p.bannerImage||'';delete p.avatarImage;delete p.bannerImage;localStorage.setItem('larpLifeProfile',JSON.stringify(p));const stripped={...game,profile:p};localStorage.setItem('larpLifeSave',JSON.stringify(stripped));Promise.all([storeProfileAsset('avatarImage',avatarImage),storeProfileAsset('bannerImage',bannerImage)]).catch(()=>notify('Profile text saved, but image storage failed. Try a smaller image or free browser storage.'))}catch(e){notify('Could not save game/profile. Browser storage may be full.')}}
async function restoreProfileAssets(){try{const [avatarImage,bannerImage]=await Promise.all([getProfileAsset('avatarImage'),getProfileAsset('bannerImage')]);game.profile=game.profile||{};if(avatarImage)game.profile.avatarImage=avatarImage;if(bannerImage)game.profile.bannerImage=bannerImage;renderProfile()}catch(e){/* Keep profile usable even if IndexedDB is unavailable. */}}

separate=localStorage.getItem('larpLifeProfile');if(separate)game.profile={...game.profile,...JSON.parse(separate)};}catch(e){}const legacyAvatar=game.profile.avatarImage||'',legacyBanner=game.profile.bannerImage||'';if(legacyAvatar||legacyBanner){storeProfileAsset('avatarImage',legacyAvatar).catch(()=>{});storeProfileAsset('bannerImage',legacyBanner).catch(()=>{});delete function gainXP(n){game.xp+=n;while(game.xp>=game.level*100){game.xp-=game.level*100;game.level++;notify('LEVEL UP! You are now level '+game.level+' ✨')}}
function grind(){notify('Use Creator Studio to record, edit, and publish videos.')}
function flex(){notify('Open Creator Studio to publish a video.')}
function buy(id){const u=game.upgrades.find(x=>x.id===id),c=cost(u);if(game.cash<c){notify('Not enough LARP Bucks. Keep grinding!');return}game.cash-=c;u.owned++;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+c;game.clout+=u.clout;gainXP(Math.max(10,Math.floor(u.clout/2)));addFeed('Purchased '+u.name,'+'+u.clout+' clout');render();checkQuests();notify('Upgrade unlocked: '+u.name)}
function renderUpgrades(){$('#upgrades').innerHTML='';game.upgrades.forEach(u=>{const c=cost(u),el=document.createElement('article');el.className='card upgrade';el.innerHTML=`<div class="upgrade-icon">${u.icon}</div><h3></h3><p></p><div class="smallmuted"></div><div class="upgrade-foot"><span class="price"></span><button class="primary">Buy</button></div>`;el.querySelector('h3').textContent=u.name;el.querySelector('p').textContent=u.desc;el.querySelector('.smallmuted').textContent=(u.rate?'+ '+compact(u.rate)+' / sec · ':'')+'+'+u.click+' click power · Owned: '+u.owned;el.querySelector('.price').textContent='🪙 '+compact(c);const b=el.querySelector('button');b.disabled=game.cash<c;b.textContent=game.cash<c?'Need more':'Buy upgrade';b.onclick=()=>buy(u.id);$('#upgrades').append(el)})}
function renderFeed(){$('#feed').innerHTML='';if(!game.feed.length){$('#feed').innerHTML='<div class="smallmuted">Your next totally-real flex will show up here.</div>';return}game.feed.forEach(x=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='logitem';const a=document.createElement('span'),b=document.createElement('span');a.textContent=x.msg;b.textContent=x.reward;el.append(a,b);$('#feed').append(el)})}
function renderQuests(){$('#quests').innerHTML='';quests.forEach(q=>{const done=game.doneQuests.includes(q.id),ok=q.check(game);const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='quest';row.innerHTML=`<div class="check">${done?'✓':'☆'}</div><div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><b></b><p></p><p style="color:var(--gold)">Reward: +${q.reward} LARP Bucks</p></div><button ${done||!ok?'disabled':''}>${done?'Claimed':ok?'Claim':'In progress'}</button>`;row.querySelector('b').textContent=q.title;row.querySelectorAll('p')[0].textContent=q.desc;row.querySelector('button').onclick=()=>{if(done||!q.check(game))return;game.doneQuests.push(q.id);game.cash+=q.reward;gainXP(10);addFeed('Quest complete: '+q.title,'+$'+q.reward);render();notify('Quest reward claimed! +$'+q.reward)};$('#quests').append(row)})}

function postVideo(){const d=game.studioDraft;if(!d||!d.edited){notify('Record and edit your video before posting.');return}const worn=currentClothes();let clothingXP=0,clothingRep=0;for(const cat of clothingCategories){const item=cat.items.find(i=>i.id===worn[cat.id]);if(item){clothingXP+=item.cost>=100000?15:item.cost>=10000?8:item.cost>=1000?4:item.cost>0?2:0;clothingRep+=item.cost>=100000?8:item.cost>=10000?4:item.cost>=1000?2:item.cost>0?1:0}}const activeEditor=(game.editors||[]).find(e=>e.hired&&!e.fired);const views=100+game.level*25+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)+Math.floor(game.clout/5)+(activeEditor?activeEditor.viewsBonus:0)+clothingRep*8;const reward=25+Math.floor(views*.2)+(d.style==='Fast cuts + captions'?25:0)+(activeEditor?activeEditor.rewardBonus:0);const video={id:Date.now(),title:d.title,caption:d.caption,concept:d.concept,style:d.style,views,reward};game.studioVideos=game.studioVideos||[];game.studioVideos.push(video);game.cash+=reward;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+reward;game.clicks=(game.clicks||0)+1;game.flexes=(game.flexes||0)+1;game.clout=(game.clout||0)+Math.max(3,Math.floor(views/20))+clothingRep;game.subscribers=(game.subscribers||0)+Math.max(1,Math.floor(views/50))*((game.courses||[]).includes('digitalMarketing')?1.2:1);
if((game.courses||[]).includes('communication'))game.clout+=2;gainXP(20+clothingXP+(activeEditor?activeEditor.xpBonus:0)+((game.courses||[]).includes('editingBasics')?8:0));addFeed('Published video: '+video.title,'+$'+compact(reward));game.messages=game.messages||[];const hateLines=['Your flex is giving clearance aisle.','Bro rented the confidence too.','Is this a parody or your actual life?','The outfit is loud; the bank account is quiet.','Another day, another suspicious luxury tour.'];game.messages.unshift({id:'hate'+Date.now(),type:'hater',from:['@RealTalkRico','@NoCapNora','@CommentSectionCEO','@BudgetDetective','@ReceiptChecker'][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],title:'New comment-section DM',text:hateLines[Math.floor(Math.random()*hateLines.length)],done:false});game.messages=game.messages.slice(0,60);if(activeEditor){const owed=activeEditor.fee||0;const paid=Math.min(game.cash,Math.max(0,owed));game.cash-=paid;game.editorDebt=(game.editorDebt||0)+(owed-paid);if(paid<owed){game.editorUnpaidVideos=(game.editorUnpaidVideos||0)+1;activeEditor.unpaid=(activeEditor.unpaid||0)+1;addFeed('Editor underpaid: '+activeEditor.name,'Owed $'+compact(owed-paid))}else{game.editorUnpaidVideos=0;activeEditor.unpaid=0;addFeed('Paid editor: '+activeEditor.name,'-$'+compact(owed))}if((game.editorUnpaidVideos||0)>=5&&!game.exposed){game.exposed=true;game.auraPenalty=(game.auraPenalty||0)+25;game.clout=Math.max(0,game.clout-250);addFeed('EXPOSED: editor posted receipts about your LARP era','-25 aura');game.messages.unshift({id:'expose'+Date.now(),type:'hater',from:'@FormerEditor',title:'EXPOSED YOU',text:'You underpaid or skipped payment for five videos. Pay your editor fairly.')}}const secretTitle=(video.title||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ');if(secretTitle==='jiggle giggle farty pants'&&!game.secretUnlocked){game.secretUnlocked=true;$('#secretTabBtn').style.display='';addFeed('Secret tab unlocked by a legendary video title!','🔐 SECRET');notify('SECRET UNLOCKED! function renderInbox(){

   {id:'mikebrand',name:'Mike Brand',kind:'Brand deal',desc:'A major creator brand wants a polished campaign video. Requires 150,000 followers and 3 posted videos.',reward:25000,need:3,requiredFollowers:150000,done:false}
  ];game.inboxInitialized=true;
 }
 // Ensure older saved games also receive a separate weird/creepy DM category.
 if(!game.messages.some(m=>m.type==='weird')){game.messages.push({id:'weird1',type:'weird',from:'@UnknownViewer',title:'Weird DM',text:'I keep seeing your videos everywhere… strange coincidence, huh?',reply:'Block / ignore',done:false},{id:'weird2',type:'weird',from:'@LateNightAccount',title:'Creepy DM',text:'Your room tour showed way too much. Maybe keep some things private.',reply:'Block / ignore',done:false});}
 // Upgrade older saves safely and add the new Mike deal even when the player already has a save.
 game.collabs.forEach(c=>{if(c.requiredFollowers==null)c.requiredFollowers=c.kind==='Replica company'?5000:5000});
 if(!game.collabs.some(c=>c.id==='mikebrand'))game.collabs.push({id:'mikebrand',name:'Mike Brand',kind:'Brand deal',desc:'A major creator brand wants a polished campaign video. Requires 150,000 followers and 3 posted videos.',reward:25000,need:3,requiredFollowers:150000,done:false});
 const extraDeals=[{id:'collabE',name:'CloudNine Sneakers',kind:'Footwear brand deal',desc:'Film a sneaker rotation and styling video.',reward:5200,need:2,requiredFollowers:12000,done:false},{id:'collabF',name:'GlowUp Skincare',kind:'Lifestyle brand deal',desc:'Publish a morning routine product showcase.',reward:7800,need:3,requiredFollowers:25000,done:false},{id:'collabG',name:'Volt Gaming',kind:'Gaming brand deal',desc:'Create a gaming setup showcase.',reward:12000,need:4,requiredFollowers:50000,done:false},{id:'collabH',name:'Metro Streetwear',kind:'Fashion brand deal',desc:'Post a streetwear lookbook.',reward:18000,need:3,requiredFollowers:80000,done:false}];extraDeals.forEach(d=>{if(!game.collabs.some(c=>c.id===d.id))game.collabs.push({...d})});
 const haterList=$('#haterMessageList'),otherList=$('#otherMessageList'),weirdList=$('#weirdMessageList');
 haterList.innerHTML='';otherList.innerHTML='';if(weirdList)weirdList.innerHTML='';
 const renderMessage=(m)=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='message-card';
  const b=document.createElement('b');b.textContent=(m.type==='hater'?'💢 ':m.type==='weird'?'👁️ ':'🤝 ')+m.from+' — '+m.title;
  const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=m.text;el.append(b,p);
  if(!m.done){
   const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='message-actions';
   const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.textContent=m.type==='hater'?'Reply / make a response video':m.type==='weird'?'🚫 Block / ignore':(m.reply||'Respond');
   btn.onclick=()=>{if(m.type==='hater'){game.clout=(game.clout||0)+3;gainXP(5);addFeed('Responded to DM from '+m.from,'+3 reputation');notify('Reply sent. Turn the drama into content!')}else if(m.type==='weird'){m.blocked=true;notify('Account blocked.    actions.append(btn);
   if(m.type!=='hater'){const no=document.createElement('button');no.textContent='Decline';no.onclick=()=>{m.done=true;saveSilent();renderInbox()};actions.append(no)}
   el.append(actions);
  }else{const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='smallmuted';status.textContent=m.accepted?'Accepted · waiting for a published video':'Handled';el.append(status)}
  return el;
 };
 const haters=game.messages.filter(m=>m.type==='hater'),weird=game.messages.filter(m=>m.type==='weird'),others=game.messages.filter(m=>m.type!=='hater'&&m.type!=='weird');
 haters.forEach(m=>haterList.append(renderMessage(m)));others.forEach(m=>otherList.append(renderMessage(m)));if(weirdList)weird.forEach(m=>weirdList.append(renderMessage(m)));
 if(!haters.length)haterList.innerHTML='<p class="smallmuted">No hate DMs yet. Publish a video to stir up the comments.</p>';
 if(!others.length)otherList.innerHTML='<p class="smallmuted">No other messages right now.</p>';if(weirdList&&!weird.length)weirdList.innerHTML='<p class="smallmuted">No weird messages right now.</p>';
 const cl=$('#collabList');cl.innerHTML='';
 game.collabs.forEach(c=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='message-card';
  const b=document.createElement('b');b.textContent=(c.kind==='Replica company'?'👟 ':'🤝 ')+c.name;
  const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=c.desc+' Reward: $'+compact(c.reward)+'. Unlock: '+compact(c.requiredFollowers||5000)+' followers.';
  el.append(b,p);
  const eligible=(game.subscribers||0)>=(c.requiredFollowers||5000);
  const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.disabled=c.done||c.accepted||!eligible;
  btn.textContent=c.done?'Completed':!eligible?'Locked · Need '+compact(c.requiredFollowers||5000)+' followers':c.accepted?'Accepted — '+Math.max(0,c.need-((game.studioVideos||[]).length-(c.acceptedAtVideos||0)))+' videos to go':'Accept deal';
  btn.onclick=()=>{if((game.subscribers||0)<(c.requiredFollowers||5000)){notify('Reach '+compact(c.requiredFollowers||5000)+' followers to unlock '+c.name+'.');return}c.accepted=true;c.acceptedAtVideos=(game.studioVideos||[]).length;notify('Deal accepted! Publish '+c.need+' video(s) to complete it.');saveSilent();renderInbox()};
  el.append(btn);
  if(c.accepted&&!c.done&&((game.studioVideos||[]).length-(c.acceptedAtVideos||0))>=c.need){
   const claim=document.createElement('button');claim.className='primary';claim.style.marginLeft='8px';claim.textContent='Claim $'+compact(c.reward);
   claim.onclick=()=>{c.done=true;game.cash+=c.reward;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+c.reward;addFeed('Completed collab: '+c.name,'+$'+compact(c.reward));saveSilent();render();renderInbox();notify('Collab paid! +$'+compact(c.reward))};el.append(claim)
  }
  cl.append(el)
 });
 $('#unreadCount').textContent=haters.filter(m=>!m.done).length+' active haters';
 renderEditors();
}
function ensureMarkets(){game.stockPrices=game.stockPrices||{};game.stockHoldings=game.stockHoldings||{};stockCatalog.forEach(st=>{if(!Number.isFinite(Number(game.stockPrices[st.id]))||Number(game.stockPrices[st.id])<=0)game.stockPrices[st.id]=st.price;if(!Number.isFinite(Number(game.stockHoldings[st.id])))game.stockHoldings[st.id]=0})}

function renderGigs(){const host=$('#gigBoard');if(!host)return;host.innerHTML='';const active=sideGigs.find(g=>g.id===game.activeGigId);const remaining=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(((game.gigReadyAt||0)-Date.now())/1000));$('#gigStatus').textContent=active&&remaining>0?'Working: '+active.name+' · '+remaining+' seconds left.':'No side gig in progress. function startGig(id){if((game.gigReadyAt||0)>Date.now()){notify('Finish your current side gig first.');return}const g=sideGigs.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!g)return;game.activeGigId=id;game.gigReadyAt=Date.now()+g.duration*1000;saveSilent();renderGigs();notify(g.name+' started. function tickGig(){if(!game.activeGigId||!(game.gigReadyAt>0)||Date.now()<game.gigReadyAt){renderGigs();return}const g=sideGigs.find(x=>x.id===game.activeGigId);game.activeGigId=null;game.gigReadyAt=0;if(g){let pay=g.pay,note='';if(g.id==='delivery'&&Math.random()<.18){pay=Math.floor(pay*.55);note=' A fictional complication reduced the payout.';game.auraPenalty=Math.min(100,(game.auraPenalty||0)+2)}game.cash+=pay;game.lifetime=(game.lifetime||0)+pay;game.workXP=(game.workXP||0)+g.xp;gainXP(g.xp);game.gigHistory=game.gigHistory||[];game.gigHistory.unshift({name:g.name,pay});game.gigHistory=game.gigHistory.slice(0,8);addFeed('Completed side gig: '+g.name,'+$'+compact(pay));notify('Side gig complete! +$'+compact(pay)+' · +'+g.xp+' XP.'+note)}saveSilent();render();renderGigs()}
function renderFinance(){game.courses=Array.isArray(game.courses)?game.courses:[];$('#savingsBalance').textContent='$'+compact(game.savings||0);$('#savingsHint').textContent=(game.savings||0)>=1000?'Nice cushion. function investTick(){game.marketTicks=(game.marketTicks||0)+1;game.stockTicks=(game.stockTicks||0)+1;if(game.stockTicks>=15){game.stockTicks=0;ensureMarkets();stockCatalog.forEach(st=>{const old=Number(game.stockPrices[st.id])||st.price;game.stockPrices[st.id]=Math.max(1,Math.round(old*(1+(Math.random()*0.12)-0.055)))});renderStocks();saveSilent()}if(game.marketTicks>=60){game.marketTicks=0;if((game.portfolio||0)>0){const change=(Math.random()*0.06)-0.025;game.portfolio=Math.max(0,Math.round(game.portfolio*(1+change)));}if((game.savings||0)>0)game.savings=Math.round(game.savings*1.002);saveSilent();renderFinance()}}

Check the spelling and try again.';return}if(game.secretCodeRedeemed){notify('Everything is already unlocked!');return}grantEverything()};

$('#depositBtn').onclick=()=>{const amount=Math.floor(Number($('#savingsAmount').value));if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<=0){notify('Enter a valid deposit amount.');return}if(amount>game.cash){notify('You do not have enough spendable cash.');return}game.cash-=amount;game.savings=(game.savings||0)+amount;saveSilent();render();notify('Deposited $'+compact(amount)+' into savings.')};$('#withdrawBtn').onclick=()=>{const amount=Math.floor(Number($('#savingsAmount').value));if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<=0){notify('Enter a valid withdrawal amount.');return}if(amount>(game.savings||0)){notify('Your savings balance is too low.');return}game.savings-=amount;game.cash+=amount;saveSilent();render();notify('Withdrew $'+compact(amount)+' from savings.')};$('#investBtn').onclick=()=>{const amount=Math.floor(Number($('#investAmount').value));if(!Number.isFinite(amount)||amount<=0){notify('Enter a valid investment amount.');return}if(amount>game.cash){notify('You do not have enough spendable cash.');return}game.cash-=amount;game.portfolio=(game.portfolio||0)+amount;game.invested=(game.invested||0)+amount;saveSilent();render();notify('Invested $'+compact(amount)+'. Market value can rise or fall.')};$('#sellInvestBtn').onclick=()=>{const amount=game.portfolio||0;if(amount<=0){notify('You have no investments to sell.');return}game.cash+=amount;game.portfolio=0;game.invested=0;saveSilent();render();notify('Sold your fund holdings for $'+compact(amount)+'.')};
$('#workBtn').onclick=work;$('#openStudioBtn').onclick=()=>document.querySelector('[data-tab=studioPane]').click();$('#openInboxBtn').onclick=()=>document.querySelector('[data-tab=inboxPane]').click();$('#recordBtn').onclick=recordVideo;$('#editBtn').onclick=editVideo;$('#postVideoBtn').onclick=postVideo;$('#saveBtn').onclick=save;$('#resetBtn').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Reset all LARP LIFE progress? This cannot be undone.')){game={cash:0,lifetime:0,clicks:0,clout:0,level:1,xp:0,flexes:0,workXP:0,shifts:0,savings:0,portfolio:0,invested:0,marketTicks:0,stockPrices:{},stockHoldings:{},stockTicks:0,gigReadyAt:0,activeGigId:null,gigHistory:[],courses:[],houseLevel:1,houseOwned:[],housePaint:'purple',houseDecor:'minimal',avatarGender:'him',avatarOutfit:'budget',clothesOwned:['budget'],avatarClothes:{shoes:'shoe_basic',shirts:'shirt_basic',jackets:'jacket_none',pants:'pants_basic',shorts:'shorts_basic',socks:'socks_basic',hats:'hat_none'},clothingCategory:'shoes',billTicks:0,lateBills:0,editors:[],editorDebt:0,editorUnpaidVideos:0,exposed:false,auraPenalty:0,studioDraft:null,studioVideos:[],secretUnlocked:false,secretCodeRedeemed:false,messages:[],collabs:[],shiftReadyAt:0,recordingUntil:0,editingUntil:0,editingDuration:60,upgrades:initialUpgrades.map(x=>({...x})),doneQuests:[],feed:[],shiftFeed:[]};try{localStorage.removeItem('larpLifeSave');localStorage.removeItem('larpLifeProfile');storeProfileAsset('avatarImage','').catch(()=>{});storeProfileAsset('bannerImage','').catch(()=>{})}catch(e){}render();renderFeed();notify('Fresh start. Back to the grind.')}};$('#clearFeed').onclick=()=>{game.feed=[];renderFeed();notify('Flex feed cleared.')};
$('#saveBtn').title='Save your progress to this browser';$('#resetBtn').title='Reset your game';

// Local AI bridge: when this game is served by server.js, messages go to a real model.
let larpGPTRemoteReady=false;
async function larpGPTAskReal(message){
 const status=$('#larpgptStatus'), note=$('#larpgptNote');
 const context={cash:game.cash,savings:game.savings,level:game.level,xp:game.xp,clout:game.clout,followers:game.subscribers||0,bills:bills().total,editorDebt:game.editorDebt||0,houseLevel:game.houseLevel,upgrades:(game.upgrades||[]).map(u=>({name:u.name,cost:cost(u),owned:u.owned,rate:u.rate,click:u.click,clout:u.clout})),stocks:game.stockHoldings||{},stockPrices:game.stockPrices||{},activeGig:game.activeGigId||null};
 const r=await fetch('/api/chat',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({message,context})});
 if(!r.ok){let d={};try{d=await r.json()}catch{}throw new Error(d.error||('AI server returned '+r.status))}
 const data=await r.json();if(!data.reply)throw new Error('The AI returned an empty reply.');
 larpGPTRemoteReady=true;if(status)status.textContent='● Connected to real AI';if(note)note.textContent='AI-powered advice · game stats included · fictional game economy';return data.reply;
}
function larpGPTReply(message){
 const q=message.toLowerCase(), cash=Number(game.cash)||0, save=Number(game.savings)||0, bill=bills().total, rank=[...ranks].reverse().find(x=>cash>=x.cash)||ranks[0];
 const upgrades=(game.upgrades||[]).map(u=>({...u,cost:cost(u)})).filter(u=>u.cost<=cash).sort((a,b)=>(b.rate*1.1+b.click*5+b.clout*.04)-(a.rate*1.1+a.click*5+a.clout*.04));
 const best=upgrades[0]; const gigs=sideGigs.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.pay/b.duration)-(a.pay/a.duration));
 if(/what.*buy|buy.*next|recommend|shopping|purchase|upgrade/.test(q)){
  if(save<bill*2&&cash>bill)return `My call: build a cushion first. Your next bill cycle is about $${compact(bill)} and savings are $${compact(save)}. Try to keep roughly 2 bill cycles safe before splurging. Then ${best?'consider '+best.name+' for $'+compact(best.cost)+'.':'save toward a useful upgrade you can afford.'}`;
  if(best)return `Based on your current $${compact(cash)} cash and ${rank.title} rank, I’d look at ${best.name} ($${compact(best.cost)}). ${best.rate?'It adds about $'+compact(best.rate)+' per second plus click power.':'It adds click power and clout.'} Keep enough cash for bills, though—don’t buy just because the button lights up.`;
  return `Save toward the next practical upgrade. You have $${compact(cash)} cash, $${compact(save)} in savings, and bills around $${compact(bill)} per cycle. Small, affordable upgrades beat going broke for a flex.`;
 }
 if(/stock|share|invest|market|ticker/.test(q))return `Stocks in this game are fictional and can drop as well as rise. Current cash: $${compact(cash)}; savings: $${compact(save)}; bills: about $${compact(bill)} per cycle. Cover bills and keep an emergency cushion first. If you experiment, start with a small amount you can afford to lose—don’t treat a short price jump as a guarantee.`;
 if(/job|money|cash|earn|rich|income|gig|work/.test(q)){const active=sideGigs.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.pay/a.duration-a.pay/b.duration)[0];return `For quick game cash, side gigs pay when their timer finishes. Best payout per second on paper: ${active.name} ($${active.pay} in ${active.duration}s), while ${sideGigs.find(g=>g.id==='freelance').name} pays $120 in 35s. You can also run your regular shift. Current cash: $${compact(cash)}. Watch your bill timer and don’t spend every payout.`}
 if(/larp|costume|armor|weapon|gear|kit|event|battle|sword|shield|clothing|what should i wear/.test(q))return `LARP kit tip: start with comfortable footwear, weather-appropriate layers, and one durable costume piece before buying flashy accessories. Check your event’s safety rules and approved foam weapon standards; don’t bring real weapons. For a budget loadout, prioritize boots you can move in, a tunic or shirt, belt/pouches, then a safe foam prop. Test fit and mobility before the event.`;
 if(/bill|rent|save|saving|debt|editor/.test(q))return `Money check: cash $${compact(cash)}, savings $${compact(save)}, bills about $${compact(bill)} each cycle, and editor debt $${compact(game.editorDebt||0)}. I’d protect bill money first, pay down editor debt if any, then build savings. A fancy upgrade can wait if it risks a late bill.`;
 if(/video|creator|youtube|tiktok|post|follower|content/.test(q))return `Creator strategy: record, edit, then post consistently. Your game stats: ${compact(game.subscribers||0)} followers and ${(game.studioVideos||[]).length} published videos. Try a clear hook in the first seconds, a simple title, and a repeatable series. Check DMs for deals, but read the requirements and make sure you can deliver before accepting.`;
 if(/hello|hey|hi\b|sup|who are you/.test(q))return `Hey, player! I’m LarpGPT, your tiny desktop sidekick. I can help plan purchases, earn LARP Bucks, manage bills, choose fictional stocks, or plan a real-world LARP kit. What are we working on?`;
 return `Here’s my game-plan take: you’re ${rank.title} with $${compact(cash)} cash, $${compact(save)} saved, and ${compact(game.level)} level. Focus on one goal at a time: cover bills, choose a useful upgrade, then build your creator or LARP kit. Ask me “what should I buy next?”, “how do I make more money?”, “LARP tips”, or “should I buy stocks?”`;
}
function larpGPTAdd(text,who){const chat=$('#larpgptChat');if(!chat)return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='larpgpt-msg '+who;el.textContent=text;chat.append(el);chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight;return el}
async function larpGPTSend(text){const input=$('#larpgptInput'),send=$('#larpgptSend');const msg=(text===undefined?input.value:text).trim();if(!msg)return;larpGPTAdd(msg,'user');if(input)input.value='';if(send)send.disabled=true;const pending=larpGPTAdd('Thinking…','bot');try{const reply=await larpGPTAskReal(msg);pending.textContent=reply;}catch(err){pending.textContent=larpGPTReply(msg)+'\n\n[AI connection note: '+(err.message||'local AI server unavailable')+'. Start the included server and open the game at http://localhost:3000. This reply is the offline fallback.]';const status=$('#larpgptStatus'),note=$('#larpgptNote');if(status)status.textContent='● Offline fallback';if(note)note.textContent='To enable real AI, run the included server with your API key.';}finally{if(send)send.disabled=false;}}
$('#larpgptMascot').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#larpgptPanel').classList.toggle('open');if($('#larpgptPanel').classList.contains('open'))$('#larpgptInput').focus()});$('#larpgptClose').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#larpgptPanel').classList.remove('open'));$('#larpgptSend').addEventListener('click',()=>larpGPTSend());$('#larpgptInput').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')larpGPTSend()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-larpquick]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>larpGPTSend(b.dataset.larpquick)));
// Drag the little buddy around the screen without interfering with its chat button.
(()=>{const buddy=$('#larpgptBuddy'),handle=$('#larpgptMascot');let dragging=false,sx=0,sy=0,left=0,top=0,moved=false;handle.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button!==0)return;dragging=true;moved=false;sx=e.clientX;sy=e.clientY;const r=buddy.getBoundingClientRect();left=r.left;top=r.top;handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)});handle.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!dragging)return;const dx=e.clientX-sx,dy=e.clientY-sy;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>5)moved=true;if(moved){buddy.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-buddy.offsetWidth,left+dx))+'px';buddy.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerHeight-buddy.offsetHeight,top+dy))+'px';buddy.style.right='auto';buddy.style.bottom='auto';const panel=$('#larpgptPanel');panel.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-panel.offsetWidth,left+dx-270))+'px';panel.style.right='auto';panel.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerHeight-panel.offsetHeight,top+dy-panel.offsetHeight-10))+'px';panel.style.bottom='auto'}});handle.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{dragging=false});handle.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(moved){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();moved=false}},true)})();


// Decorative snow and sparkles; both layers ignore clicks so gameplay remains clickable.
(()=>{
 const layer=document.createElement('div');layer.id='larpSnowLayer';layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.body.appendChild(layer);
 const count=window.matchMedia('(max-width: 600px)').matches?34:58;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const f=document.createElement('span');f.className='larp-snowflake';f.textContent=Math.random()>.72?'❄':'•';f.style.setProperty('--x',(Math.random()*100)+'%');f.style.setProperty('--size',(Math.random()*9+5)+'px');f.style.setProperty('--opacity',(Math.random()*.55+.22).toFixed(2));f.style.setProperty('--duration',(Math.random()*12+10)+'s');f.style.setProperty('--delay',(-Math.random()*22)+'s');f.style.setProperty('--drift',(Math.random()*100-50)+'px');layer.appendChild(f)}
 let lastSparkle=0;
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]'))return;
  const now=performance.now();if(now-lastSparkle<35)return;lastSparkle=now;
  const symbols=['✦','✧','✨','⋆','✳'];const colors=['#fff4a8','#c9f4ff','#e7c7ff','#ffc8ed','#ffffff'];
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const el=document.createElement('span');el.className='larp-click-sparkle';el.textContent=symbols[Math.floor(Math.random()*symbols.length)];el.style.left=e.clientX+'px';el.style.top=e.clientY+'px';el.style.setProperty('--sz',(Math.random()*12+9)+'px');el.style.setProperty('--sparkle-color',colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)]);const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,d1=8+Math.random()*22,d2=25+Math.random()*50;el.style.setProperty('--dx1',(Math.cos(a)*d1)+'px');el.style.setProperty('--dy1',(Math.sin(a)*d1)+'px');el.style.setProperty('--dx2',(Math.cos(a)*d2)+'px');el.style.setProperty('--dy2',(Math.sin(a)*d2-12)+'px');document.body.appendChild(el);el.addEventListener('animationend',()=>el.remove(),{once:true})}
 },{passive:true});
})();

load();applyGameTheme((game.theme&&game.theme.name)||'default',(game.theme&&game.theme.custom)||defaultThemeCustom);fillProfileEditor();render();renderFeed();timer=setInterval(()=>{const n=perSec();if(n>0){game.cash+=n;game.clout+=Math.floor(n/10)}game.billTicks=(game.billTicks||0)+1;investTick();if(game.billTicks>=300){game.billTicks=0;payBills()}else{renderBillTimer();if(n>0)render()}tickShift();tickGig();if(game.recordingUntil&&Date.now()>=game.recordingUntil){game.recordingUntil=0;$('#recordStatus').textContent='Recording complete! Your draft is ready to edit.';if(game.studioDraft)game.studioDraft.recorded=true;$('#recordBtn').disabled=false;$('#editBtn').disabled=false;saveSilent()}if(game.editingUntil&&Date.now()>=game.editingUntil){game.editingUntil=0;if(game.studioDraft){game.studioDraft.edited=true;$('#editStatus').textContent='Edit complete: '+game.studioDraft.style;$('#postVideoBtn').disabled=false;$('#editBtn').disabled=false;saveSilent();renderStudio()}}},1000);
window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{try{const p={...(game.profile||{})};delete p.avatarImage;delete p.bannerImage;localStorage.setItem('larpLifeProfile',JSON.stringify(p));localStorage.setItem('larpLifeSave',JSON.stringify({...game,profile:p}))}catch(e){}});
</script>

<audio id="larpBackgroundMusic" loop preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
<script>
(()=>{
 const audio=document.getElementById('larpBackgroundMusic');
 const btn=document.getElementById('musicToggle');
 if(!audio||!btn)return;
 audio.volume=0.22;
 const paint=()=>{const playing=!audio.paused&&!audio.ended;btn.textContent=playing?'❚❚ Pause music':'▶ Play music';btn.classList.toggle('music-on',playing);btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(playing));};
 btn.addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{if(audio.paused){await audio.play();}else{audio.pause();}paint();}catch(e){btn.textContent='Tap to play music';}});
 audio.addEventListener('play',paint);audio.addEventListener('pause',paint);
 // Attempt autoplay; browsers may require the player button to be clicked first.
 audio.play().then(paint).catch(paint);
})();
</script>
